pages.text: Place the Weather Obelisk under open sky. Supply a Firework Rocket and 1,000 mB of the matching fluid. Use Cloud Seed for rain, Concentrated Cloud Seed for thunder, or Liquid Sunshine to clear the sky.
If the obelisk waits, clear the blocks above it, check its redstone setting and verify both the rocket and fluid amount. Make the fluids in the $(l:enderio:machines/vat)VAT$(/l).

Aim the Block Detector’s sensor at the space to watch and connect a lamp or redstone circuit to the opposite side. A block in the watched space turns the signal on. Remove the block to test that it turns off.
